messages:
tara_secops: Heads-up: security advisory — internal metrics agent 'probelet' (v0.9.3) ships with insecure defaults that grant elevated caps and logs sensitive tokens to stdout. We discovered this in a host scan. Immediate actions required for Hosted & Dedicated fleets; Private customers will receive guidance. 48-hour mitigation target.

kevin_devx: how widespread is probelet? which clusters/namespaces?

tara_secops: It's used by perf/telemetry teams in ~40 clusters: infra-monitoring, model-metrics, and several customer-facing dataplatform clusters. The risky default config enables CAP_SYS_ADMIN & CAP_NET_ADMIN and mounts /var/log with hostPath; also debug logging prints environment variables including PROBELET_API_TOKEN.

sylvia_sre: Impact: exposed tokens in node logs + capability set could allow local privilege escalation via container escape in some runtimes. We should assume tokens in older logs may be valid.

jon_cto: Immediate ask: disable probelet by default on hosted clusters and rotate any tokens provisioned by it. Also we need a remediation playbook for Dedicated and Private.

tara_secops: Agreed. Short mitigation steps: (1) On controlled clusters, apply a mutation webhook patch to add securityContext dropCaps & remove hostPath mounts, and set log level=info. (2) Revoke all PROBELET_API_TOKEN values from the token store and issue fresh tokens with least privilege. (3) Sweep logs for occurrences of "PROBELET_API_TOKEN" and mark for rotation. (4) For images using v0.9.3, upgrade to v0.9.4 which removes env logging and tightens caps.

kevin_devx: Can we get a k8s patch snippet?

tara_secops: Use this patch to enforce secure defaults (apply via kubectl patch or kustomize):

```
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: probelet
  namespace: telemetry
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: probelet
        image: acme/probelet:0.9.4
        env:
        - name: LOG_LEVEL
          value: "info"
        securityContext:
          capabilities:
            drop: ["ALL"]
          runAsUser: 1000
      volumes:
      - name: logdir
        emptyDir: {}
```

ops-bot: Created task TASK-5021: "Probelet insecure defaults - roll mitigation" assigned to @sylvia_sre. ETA 48h.

sylvia_sre: Plan for hosted: (A) apply webhook mutation to enforce emptyDir for log mounts + drop caps cluster-wide (B) rollout v0.9.4 via canary then full rollout (C) run log-scan job to find leaked tokens and call token-rotation script.

tara_secops: Token rotation notes: any token referenced in logs in the last 90 days is considered compromised. Use `tools/token-rotate --provider=secrets --name=probelet-* --reason=probelet-leak` and record rotation PR in sec-rotations channel.

kevin_devx: For Dedicated customers: we can't change their clusters. What's our customer comms?

tara_secops: We'll publish a KB with steps, provide sanitized mutation webhook manifests, and offer a 4-hour remote patch window for customers who opt-in. Private deployments: provide the same artifacts and recommended schedule. Must include instructions to search for tokens in node logs and rotate.

jon_cto: Any functional risk to inference pipelines from disabling CAP_NET_ADMIN or removing hostPath mounts?

kevin_devx: Some older observability setups used hostPath /var/log and network namespaces for packet capture. Those features will require migration to sidecars with explicit capabilities or eBPF-based readers running under specific privileges. We'll coordinate with teams owning those integrations.

tara_secops: Detection commands to run (SRE/Infra):
- find env leaks: `grep -R "PROBELET_API_TOKEN" /var/log/* || true`
- list pods with probelet: `kubectl get pods -A -l app=probelet -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}
{end}'`
- check container caps: `kubectl get pod -A -o json | jq '.items[].spec.containers[].securityContext'`

deploy-bot: Created incident INC-3030: "Probelet token exposure and insecure defaults". Severity: P2.

tara_secops: Action items (owners):
- SRE/Infra (@sylvia_sre, @kevin_devx): apply mutation webhook and rollout v0.9.4 to hosted & Dedicated within 48h; run log-scan and produce compromised-token list.
- Eng teams owning telemetry: audit any features depending on hostPath/CAP_NET_ADMIN and open migration PRs.
- Security (@tara_secops): publish KB, coordinate Dedicated/Private outreach, run token rotations with secrets team.

kevin_devx: Will do. Spinning up the log-scan job now.

tara_secops: Please update this thread when the webhook is live and when rotation sweep completes. We'll escalate if we find high-value tokens. :shield:
